title: 第 二十三章 灭门之祸第二十四章 炼体三层
slug: 双穿美利坚人狱苟到玄幻发育
content_zh:
炼体二层对林枫来说并没什么难度。
洗漱一番，林枫停止了今天的修炼。
其他人练武，因为经验不足，导致动作不协调，极其容易受伤。
有时候练着练着身体反而练垮了。
一旦出现岔子，身体就需要休养，这也非常的浪费时间。
也是很多人需要泡药浴的原因。
林枫倒是不用走这些弯路，省去不少的时间。
炼体最需要的就是大量气血滋养身体，年龄越小吸收越好。
好在林枫能靠吞噬野兽，直接获得本源。
说起来，两个都是食补，一个是靠身体提纯，一个是靠黑莲提纯。
目前有赵二牛这个供货商，林枫也不用费尽心思的去打猎。
只是银子不够多了，就剩了3两银子。
在穿越这边世界之前，林枫可是准备了300两白银。
又从举报赵二牛的猎户身上获得15两，田广文、田广元两人身上获得40两，加起来一共355两。
不到十天就花费352两，这笔钱对于郑宏文来说就是天文数字。
其中，加入黑虎武馆花费了10两银子。
买白牛角弓和箭花费了21两。
其中大头都是购买赵二牛的野兽。
两头老虎、一头黑熊、野猪、蟒、金钱豹等野兽一共花费352两。
练武还真是烧钱。

但提升实力也的确够快。
虽然只剩下3两白银，但林枫并未来着急。
空间之中还有白盐、酒水等物资，也足够换不少银子。
只是不知道这个赵二牛要不要。
夜幕降临，林枫吃完饭后并未出去乱逛。
逛窑子这件事也暂时搁置了。
这永关县最近乱糟糟的，实力不够还是不要去的好。
忍一步。
屋内已经漆黑一片，林枫并未选择睡在这里，而是躲在空间中。
定好闹钟，林枫便陷入了沉睡中。
翌日，林枫被闹铃声吵醒。
来到外面，看到门口的撒的面粉并未有人踩过，才放松。
没实力还是谨慎一些好。
洗漱一番，林枫直接前往善堂。
抵达善堂，众人相互打招呼。
如今，林枫已经是善堂最奇葩的人，交了钱不好练武，反而喜欢打杂，真是奇了怪了。
就连善堂的负责人孙大勇都懒得再说林枫。
人各有志，钱多烧的慌。
林枫以为今天应该没什么事，谁知刚把牛喂饱，就有人让他去收尸体。
孙大勇：“城北有尸体，林枫、郑宏文、周明你们三个都去”

周明一脸不愿，“林师兄一个人就够了，我们去干嘛”
孙大勇：“哎，这次死了5人，你们两个也去帮忙”
“知道了”
话都说到这个份上，周明也不好再说什么。
林枫牵着牛车，三人前往城北。
content_en:
The second level of body refining is not difficult for Lin Feng.
After washing up, Lin Feng stopped practicing today.
When others practice martial arts, due to lack of experience, their movements are uncoordinated and extremely easy to get injured.
Sometimes my body breaks down while practicing.
Once something goes wrong, the body needs to rest, which is also a waste of time.
This is also the reason why many people need to take medicinal baths.
Lin Feng didn't have to take these detours, which saved a lot of time.
What is most needed for body training is a large amount of Qi and blood to nourish the body. The younger you are, the better it can be absorbed.
Fortunately, Lin Feng can directly obtain the origin by devouring wild beasts.
Speaking of which, both are dietary supplements, one is purified by the body, and the other is purified by black lotus.
Currently, with Zhao Erniu as a supplier, Lin Feng doesn't have to worry about hunting.
It's just that there is not enough silver, only 3 taels of silver are left.
Before traveling to this world, Lin Feng prepared 300 taels of silver.
Another 15 taels were obtained from the hunter who reported Zhao Erniu, and 40 taels were obtained from Tian Guangwen and Tian Guangyuan, adding up to a total of 355 taels.
It cost 352 taels in less than ten days, which was an astronomical amount of money for Zheng Hongwen.
Among them, joining the Black Tiger Martial Arts School cost 10 taels of silver.
It cost 21 taels to buy a white ox horn bow and arrows.
Most of them are beasts who bought Zhao Erniu.
Two tigers, a black bear, wild boar, python, leopard and other wild animals cost a total of 352 taels.
Practicing martial arts is really expensive.
But the improvement in strength is indeed fast enough.
Although there were only 3 taels of silver left, Lin Feng was not in a hurry.
There are also white salt, wine and other supplies in the space, which are enough to exchange for a lot of silver.
I just don’t know if Zhao Erniu wants it.
As night fell, Lin Feng did not go out for a stroll after eating.
The visit to the brothel was also put on hold for the time being.
Yongguan County has been in a mess recently. If you don't have enough strength, it's better not to go there.
Take a step.
The room was already dark, and Lin Feng did not choose to sleep here, but hid in the space.
After setting the alarm clock, Lin Feng fell into a deep sleep.
The next day, Lin Feng was woken up by the alarm.
When I came outside, I relaxed when I saw that no one had stepped on the flour scattered at the door.
If you don’t have the strength, it’s better to be cautious.
After washing up, Lin Feng went directly to the shantang.
Arriving at the shrine, everyone greeted each other.
Nowadays, Lin Feng is already the weirdest person in Shantang. He pays money to practice martial arts and instead likes to do odd jobs. It's really strange.
Even Sun Dayong, the person in charge of the charity, was too lazy to talk about Lin Feng.
Everyone has their own ambitions, and money is too much to burn.
Lin Feng thought there would be nothing wrong today, but as soon as the cows were fed, someone asked him to collect the corpses.
Sun Dayong: "There are corpses in the north of the city. Lin Feng, Zheng Hongwen, and Zhou Ming should all go."
Zhou Ming looked reluctant, "Senior Brother Lin is enough alone, why should we go?"
Sun Dayong: "Hey, 5 people died this time, you two should go and help."
"Got it"
After talking about it for this reason, Zhou Ming couldn't say anything else.
Lin Feng led the ox cart and the three of them headed to the north of the city.
